analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of pusher.com/docs covered 1549 pages across multi-project topology with 100% crawl coverage and 85.88% overall confidence. Critical issue: 159 confirmed broken internal documentation links require immediate remediation. API reference coverage is weak at 30.53% despite 216 API pages detected. Freshness metadata exists on only 48.81% of pages, limiting content currency visibility. Example code reliability estimate stands at 84.53%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100%) with 1549 pages successfully indexed
High overall audit confidence at 85.88% with strong crawl confidence at 95%
Example code reliability estimate of 84.53% indicates generally functional code samples
Zero repository navigation broken links (repo_broken_links_count: 0) shows clean version control integration
Multi-project topology successfully mapped across 1554 discovered pages
risks: 159 confirmed broken internal documentation links create poor user experience and erode trust
API reference coverage at 30.53% leaves 69.47% of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
Only 48.81% of pages display last-updated metadata, obscuring content freshness for majority of docs
26 unverified links due to auth/rate-limit/server blocks represent potential hidden broken links
SEO/geo issue rate of 7.49% (approximately 116 pages) may impact discoverability
15.47% example code failure rate (100% - 84.53%) means roughly 1 in 6 code samples may not work
Link verification confidence at 80.95% is lowest confidence metric, suggesting possible undetected link issues

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 159 confirmed broken internal documentation links
Investigate and verify 26 unverified links blocked by auth/rate-limits to confirm accessibility
Expand API reference coverage from 30.53% to minimum 80% by documenting missing endpoints and improving cross-linking
Implement last-updated metadata on remaining 51.19% of pages (approximately 793 pages) to improve freshness visibility
Audit and fix failing example code (15.47% failure rate) to achieve 95%+ reliability

limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, technical correctness, or completeness of documentation substance
26 links blocked by authentication, rate-limiting, or server restrictions could not be verified and may include additional broken links
Example code reliability is estimated through static analysis; actual runtime execution in customer environments may differ
API coverage detection depends on page structure patterns; actual API surface completeness requires internal product knowledge
Freshness metadata presence does not guarantee content is actually current or that missing dates indicate stale content
